notes: litert-community/WeVisOne-VL-2B: WeVisOne-VL-2B_f16.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM fast_vlm conversion of tencent/WeVisOne-VL-2B at revision 3dad9ce8 (apache-2.0; WeChat Vision, Tencent; built on Qwen3-VL) — detection, referring, pointing, counting and OCR answers as <0>…<1000> coordinate tokens; the pixel decoder (segmentation / matting) is not in the file. Pictures are stretched to 512 x 512 with PIL BICUBIC before they are sent. LiteRT-LM 0.18.1 feeds the previous answer's stop token with a zero embedding from a conversation's second message on (files with an EMBEDDER section; the two_turn text row shows it), so every row here is a one-question conversation. Mac rows: run r2 (2026-10-24 evening JST). Also run on 2026-10-25, kept as notes: the card's two usage commands with the runtime's default cache peaked at 8,069,169,152 B (GPU) and 19,300,990,976 B (CPU) of resident memory; one engine (Python API, GPU) answered 5 conversations in a row with every answer equal to the suite's. Landed 2026-10-25: the file is on the Hub at litert-community/WeVisOne-VL-2B (upload commit 98625fccc3ce3991fe110331832254e29b5d0f3b, 2026-10-25 04:52:16 UTC = 2026-10-25 13:52 JST; main 1ed0c890b03bce7419697e01cbd7fabe74f6aa82 at the read, the file unchanged there); its LFS oid equals artifact_sha256 and its size 4899179008 B (anonymous API read 2026-10-25 15:08 JST).
quantization: float16 weights in every graph (28-layer decoder, embedder, vision encoder, vision adapter), no PREFILL_DECODE activation type declared (the GPU runs it at its float16 default); fast_vlm at 512 x 512 (256 image tokens), 8,196-wide image rows (Qwen3-VL DeepStack), KV cache 2048
